CREATE YOUR USERNAME

This is how other players will see you. Pick something — you can change it later for credits.

REBIRTH

Reset this Battle Pass season back to Tier 0 and re-lock its rewards — in exchange, every Credit and XP you earn from here on is boosted, permanently, and the boost stacks with each Rebirth.

This does not touch your Trophies, Coins, Trophy Road cars, or Tournament rewards — only Battle Pass tier, credits, and pass rewards reset.

HOW TO PLAY

2v2 rocket-powered soccer — you and an AI teammate (Blue) vs. two AI opponents (Orange). Drive into the ball to knock it toward the opponent's goal; most goals when the timer ends wins (sudden-death Overtime on a tie).

CONTROLS

DriveWASD / Arrow Keys / Gamepad Stick / Touch Stick
BoostShift / Gamepad RB or B / Boost Button
Jump / Double-JumpK / Gamepad A / Jump Button
Flip / Air RollTap K, then K again in the air (hold W/S/A/D for direction)
Power-UpP / Power-Up Button
UltimateU / Ultimate Button
Aim Teleport / Singularity / TelekinesisMouse / Tap on the field
Ball Cam (toggle)Space or C
Leave / Restart MatchOn-screen buttons, bottom-right

THE BASICS

  • Drive at the front of the ball to make it stick to your nose for a couple seconds — any other car hitting it knocks it loose.
  • Boost drains a meter that slowly refills on its own; time it for big hits and aerials rather than holding it constantly.
  • Your equipped Power-Up charges on a timer and can fire once per match half; your Ultimate charges from goals/assists/touches.

CURRENCIES — WHAT THEY'RE FOR

◆
Coins
A legacy currency carried over from an early build. Unlimited and no longer spent on anything — safe to ignore.
🏆
Trophies
Earned by winning (+3) or drawing (+1) matches. Unlock the free Trophy Road car roster as your total climbs, and now also pay for unlocking Battle Pass Premium.
✦
Credits
Earned from match results, goals, assists, and Boxes. Spent in the Item Shop on Power-Ups, Ultimates, Skins, Auras, Trails, and Box bundles.
📦
Boxes
Earned from wins, Trophy Road milestones, and the Battle Pass. Open them from the Inventory (or the lobby widget) for a random Skin, Aura, Trail, or Credits, weighted by rarity.

👥 SOCIAL

ABSOLUTE VOID
Drive: WASD / Arrows / Gamepad stick / Touch stick   Jump / Double-Jump: K / A / Jump button   Boost: Shift / RB / Boost button   Ball Cam: Space (or C)
Ball catch: get near the front of the ball and it snaps to your nose and stays put for a couple seconds — any other car touching it knocks it loose after that window.
Flips: tap K to jump, tap it again in the air for a flip. Holding W or S flips front/back even from a standstill; add A/D at the same time for a diagonal dash. Holding ONLY A/D is a side flip that also shoves you sideways, even from a standstill. No direction held = plain double jump, no rotation. Just holding W/S with no second tap keeps you level — no flip until you jump again.
While airborne (without double-tapping K), hold W or S to lean your nose forward or backward — all the way up to a full 180° if you hold it — and hold the opposite key any time to rotate back level. Add Boost while doing it to fly that direction too.
You're on Blue with an AI teammate; two Orange bots defend the other goal. Use Leave Match any time to bail out.
